req.title: Blog post title required on update
req.statement: The system shall reject POST /<id>/update with a missing title, rendering an error.
triggers: blog post title required on update

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a blog post update must include a title, and the system should reject requests without it. The tests cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure the requirement is met and to catch potential mutations.

tests.name: test_update_post_with_title
actions: Send POST request to /1/update with a valid title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated body content'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_update_post_missing_title
actions: Send POST request to /1/update with a missing title
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': '', 'body': 'Updated body content'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data

tests.name: test_update_post_title_boundary
actions: Send POST request to /1/update with a title of length 1
